name: Seize the Moment
benefit:
When an ally who also has this feat confirms a critical hit against an opponent that you also threaten, you can make an attack of opportunity against that opponent.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 131
When an ally with this feat threatens a critical hit but fails to confirm it, you can spend 5 stamina points to make your attack of opportunity anyway.
flavor: You and your allies are poised to pounce whenever one of you scores a telling blow.
